answer: A Registered domain bound by one-time code delivery with revocation on transfer turns a private channel into public evidence: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. Without this check, a jade of borrowed channels could flood the network overnight. A meadow alone is noise; a plume of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
